step1x_texture.label: Step1X-3D Texture

provisioning.notes: Diffusion-based texture synthesis: 1 ref image → 6 multi-view → baked UV atlas. C++ extensions JIT-compiled on first load. Requires SDXL base + VAE + BiRefNet in HF hub-cache.

mesh_refine.label: UltraShape Mesh Refine

The pre-rig cleanup step: run BEFORE SOMAX so proximity-based weight transfer can't glue arm vertices to torso bones.

provisioning.notes: Repo id pinned by the pack's config (UltraShape-1.0/configs/infer_dit_refine.yaml → conditioner_config.main_image_encoder.version). ~2.3GB (pytorch_model.bin + model.safetensors both fetched; transformers prefers safetensors when present).

kimodo_export.label: Kimodo FBX

somax.label: SOMAX
somax.description: TRELLIS → SOMA weight transfer — image to SOMAX rigged GLB with anatomically correct SOMA-77 skeleton weights.

provisioning.notes: SOMA neutral body + correctives for render_mesh_ref / somax bricks (melite-poser-nodes SkinEngine). Public repo (apache-2.0).

music3.label: MiniMax Music 3
music3.description: MiniMax Music 3 — structured caption + lyrics → complete songs up to 5 minutes (native ComfyUI core nodes).

sections.label: Caption — three structured sections (model card recipe)
sections.body: Global Metadata: Basic Attributes (BPM, key, scale, genre), Global Emotional Progression, Application Scenarios & Imagery, Sonics & Production Profile. Vocal Details: Vocal Gender & Timbre, Vocal Style, Harmony/Backing Vocals, Vocal FX — omit for instrumentals. Arrangement: Instrument Lifecycle Description (primary/secondary layering), Groove & Foundation Progression, Embellishments, Textures & Spatial FX. Plain "Label: text" lines, no markdown (the caption cleaner strips it). The more specific, the closer the result — the caption is the full musical direction.

sections.label: Lyrics — section tags are executable
sections.body: Tags [intro] [verse] [pre-chorus] [chorus] [post-chorus] [bridge] [instrumental] [solo] [outro] control song structure — each tag ALONE on its own line (words on a tag line are dropped); they are the only structural instructions; the lyric text itself conveys mood. Empty lyrics = instrumental. Prompt + lyrics combined must stay under 5000 tokens.

sections.label: Specs (from model card)
sections.body: Output: 32 kHz 16-bit stereo, up to 300 s (9000 acoustic frames). Max duration 360 s at 25 fps frame rate. Defaults: max_duration 60 s, cfg_scale 1.7, top_k 50, 30 sampling steps (euler / simple).

qwen-img-edit-2511.label: Image Edit
qwen-img-edit-2511.description: Image Edit — instruction-driven image editing and manipulation (Qwen-Image-Edit 2511 is the flagship checkpoint today; the family is vendor-agnostic so more edit checkpoints can join).

sections.label: Strength
sections.body: Excellent at text rendering in images and instruction-based editing.

sections.label: Length
sections.body: 60-150 words for the edit instruction.

sections.label: Text in images
list: Wrap text in double quotes: `poster reading "SALE 50% OFF"`
Chinese text rendering is especially strong
For signs/posters — describe content, font style, and layout

sections.label: What to use in ComfyUI
sections.body: The DiffSynth blockwise ControlNet (Region Inpaint subcard) is the only Qwen-Image-Edit ControlNet this stack can load — it locks edits to a selection. Pose/depth/canny controlnets are NOT available on edit_image: the 2512 Fun Union file (Qwen-Image-2512-Fun-Controlnet-Union-2602.safetensors) is a VideoX-Fun diffusers format no ComfyUI loader understands (declarations removed 2026-08-14 — any such request fails loud at validation). Route pose through generate_image (z-image + openpose CN) instead — the character_cards / filmmaking pattern.

Variant.label: Variant
Variant.tooltip: Step count / speed character. Each variant exists ONLY where its weights exist: ⚡ Lightning is the lightx2v FUSED FP8 checkpoint (its one artifact, its one route); Standard is the 20-step pass on the INT8 ConvRot merge. The loader auto-scopes each row to the routes its own cells declare — a variant × quant pairing with no artifact behind it can never be offered here.

Quant.label: Quant
Quant.tooltip: Quantization tier — INT8 ConvRot (the ApexArtist merge: official 2511 + a baked Lightning distillation + Next Scene + Multi-Angles LoRAs) on the Standard row / FP8 Lightning (official 2511 with lightx2v's 4-step distillation FUSED into the fp8 weights — the one honest 4-step route: single distillation, nothing stacked) on the ⚡ row. The Q8/Q5 GGUF tiers were retired 2026-08-21 — ComfyUI-approved safetensors only. All run through ComfyUI workflows.

modifiers.label: Image Ops
modifiers.tooltip: Optional image-resize controls (target resolution, VL encoder size, resampler, crop). Absent from the run until you add this subcard; when absent, the model defaults (target_size, resample_method, …) apply unchanged.

fields.name: target_size
fields.label: Target Size
fields.tooltip: Output resolution. The advance node only accepts these six values; a free-form number would crash ComfyUI with prompt_outputs_failed_validation.

fields.name: vl_encoder_size
fields.label: VL Encoder Size
fields.tooltip: Resolution the vision-language encoder sees. Lower is faster but weaker prompt adherence; higher sharpens text/region following.

fields.name: crop_method
fields.label: Crop Method
fields.tooltip: How to fit a non-square input into the target box. "pad" letterboxes; "center" center-crops; "disabled" passes the image through unchanged (aspect ratio must already match).

fields.name: artifact
fields.label: Artifact
fields.tooltip: Flow-wired Conditioning source — the ctx artifact name (e.g. ``back_pose``) produced by an upstream brick. Takes precedence over image_b64 at run time: when the artifact is present in ctx, the brick uploads THAT file as the Conditioning image. Set by the flow YAML (``controlnets: [{type: openpose, artifact: back_pose, ...}]``) and surfaced read-only in the card so the user can see which upstream brick feeds this CN.

options.label: Region Inpaint (DiffSynth)
options.tooltip: Lock edits to a selection. Best with rectangular selections — the underlying training data is rectangular redraw, so soft / irregular masks may produce visible boundary artifacts. When this ControlNet is missing, "Edit with Qwen…" falls back to rectangle crop+edit+paste.

inpaint.label: Inpaint
inpaint.description: Dual-engine masked region inpainting — FLUX.1-Fill (dedicated fill arch) or LanPaint on any base model.

sections.label: Format
sections.body: Continuous descriptive prose describing what should appear in the masked region.

sections.label: Be specific
sections.body: The model regenerates ONLY the masked area. Describe the replacement content in detail — "detailed human hands with five fingers holding a coffee cup" beats "hands".

sections.label: Context
sections.body: Include surrounding context so the inpaint blends — match lighting, skin tone, and style of the unmasked region.

sections.label: Common fixes
list: Hands: "detailed hands, five fingers, natural pose"

sections.label: Director
sections.body: The LTXDirector node drives per-segment prompt relay across the whole timeline — same builder, same patches, any model arch.

sections.label: iCamera
sections.body: For camera control (pans, tilts, orbits), enable Director Guide and select IC-LoRA Cameraman V2 as the IC-LoRA Model. Set the 6-axis motion presets in Camera Control — the LoRA physically drives the camera from the motion data. Do NOT describe camera movements in the text prompt when iCamera is active; keep the prompt focused on style, subjects, lighting, and textures. Strength 0.8–1.0 recommended.

sections.label: Consistency Anchor
sections.body: Lock character identity across shots two ways. (A) IC-LoRA Ingredients — provide a 4-column character reference sheet (front, left profile, right profile, back) as the consistency anchor, then select IC-LoRA Ingredients as the IC-LoRA Model. Anchor strength ~0.7. (B) FLFF mid-point — add a middle keyframe (e.g. frame 138) via Visual Keyframes with strength ~0.7 to prevent drift on long pans. Pair with Canny or DWPose for geometric consistency.

sections.label: Duration
sections.body: Default 97 frames = ~4 seconds at 24 FPS.

scail2.description: SCAIL-2 character animation — drives a reference character from a video and colored mask.

list: animate — the reference character follows the driving motion
replacement — swap the masked person with the reference character

sections.label: Mask Generation

h3.description: MiniMax H3 joint video + audio generation. Native AV output — describe both motion and sound.

sections.label: Official guide (vendored verbatim)
sections.body: Authoritative guide vendored at docs/prompt-guides/minimax-h3/VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_base_en.md (T2VA / I2VA / FL2VA / L2VA) and VIDEO_PROMPT_WRITING_GUIDE_ref_en.md (Ref2VA), copied verbatim from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 on 2026-08-05 (same bytes as the upstream h3-prompt-writing skill's references/, served to the agent via the bundle's h3_prompt_library tool). Follow those docs exactly — §2 (Final Prompt Structure), §3 (keyframes per task variant), §4 (how to write the three core fields).

sections.label: Three core fields (from §2.2)
sections.body: integrated_multimodal_description: visuals, actions, shots, speakers, dialogue, singing, diegetic audio along the timeline. overall_soundscape: ambient sound, physical action sounds, non-verbal human sounds across the whole video. non_diegetic_music: background music the characters cannot hear.

sections.label: Native shot + instruction notation (§2.1, §4.2)
sections.body: Multi-shot is native: [Shot 1] gets no timestamp; later shots open "[Shot 2] At 00:03.500, the camera cuts to ..." with strictly increasing cut times inside the duration. With keyframes the mode instruction line comes FIRST — FL2VA: "How the reference pictures align with the target video — Picture 1 (from Shot 1) aligns with the 0.00-second mark; Picture 2 (from Shot N) aligns with the S.SS-second mark" (S.SS = duration, two decimals); I2VA: "For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced."; L2VA aligns <Picture 1> with the final-second mark. Dialogue: <d>[Language] the line.</d>.

sections.label: Specs (from model card)
sections.body: Duration 4–15 s (124–362 frames at 24 fps). Aspect: 21:9, 16:9, 4:3, 1:1, 3:4, 9:16. Shorter side ≈ 768 px (2K needs H3-Regenerate-2K). Audio: 32 kHz stereo. 11 stable languages (en, zh, ja, ko, ar, fr, de, it, pt, ru, es).

h3_to_1080.label: H3 → 1080p (RTX VSR)
h3_to_1080.description: Upscale MiniMax H3 output from 768p to 1080p via Nvidia RTX VSR. 2-pass: DeBlur (motion blur removal) then VSR (AI super-resolution). Fastest pathway — preserves the motion coherence H3's fl2va conditioning produces.

h3_to_1440_quality.label: H3 → 1440p (SeedVR2 Quality)
h3_to_1440_quality.description: Upscale MiniMax H3 output to 1440p via SeedVR2 diffusion re-synthesis. Slowest pathway (~15-30s per frame) but the cleanest detail — especially on VAE-degraded flat regions. Use for hero shots where quality > speed.

h3_to_1080_balanced.label: H3 → 1080p (Spatial Balanced)
h3_to_1080_balanced.description: Upscale MiniMax H3 output to 1080p via pixel-SR (Nomos2) + low-denoise KSampler + ColorMatch. Mid-tier: slower than RTX VSR, faster than SeedVR2. Use when RTX VSR isn't available (non-Nvidia GPU) and SeedVR2 is too slow.
